engineering_change.message: Add policy-matched candidate versus four-baseline uncertainty evaluation
behavior: Evaluates a candidate separately against naive_class_prior, momentum_sign, mean_reversion_sign and volatility_normal.
Evaluates both out-of-sample and independent later shadow windows.
Applies Bonferroni correction across four baselines and two loss metrics: familywise 95%, individual 99.375%.
Enforces at least 10,000 resamples, 100 paired origins, five independent source clusters, five origins per cluster and declared cadence.
Requires candidate-minus-baseline mean Brier and log-loss differences and both temporal/source-clustered confidence interval upper bounds to be negative.
engineering_change.status: VERIFIED by exact-head full repository suite
